WITH invoice_averages AS (
  SELECT
    i.InvoiceId,
    i.BillingCountry AS Country,
    AVG(il.UnitPrice) AS average_unit_price
  FROM Invoice AS i
  JOIN InvoiceLine AS il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
  GROUP BY i.InvoiceId, i.BillingCountry
),
invoice_deviations AS (
  SELECT
    InvoiceId,
    Country,
    average_unit_price,
    average_unit_price - AVG(average_unit_price) OVER () AS deviation
  FROM invoice_averages
),
scored_invoices AS (
  SELECT
    InvoiceId,
    Country,
    average_unit_price,
    deviation,
    deviation - AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY Country) AS adjusted_deviation
  FROM invoice_deviations
)
SELECT
  InvoiceId,
  Country,
  average_unit_price AS average_unit_price,
  deviation,
  adjusted_deviation
FROM scored_invoices
ORDER BY adjusted_deviation DESC NULLS LAST
FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS WITH TIES;
